## Background

I am from China and completed my undergraduate degree in Economics at the University of British Columbia. Studying economics taught me how to think critically about real-world questions and understand the relationships between data, decisions, and human behaviour. During my undergraduate studies, I became increasingly interested in using quantitative methods to explore these questions.

## Why Data Science

I chose to pursue a Master of Data Science because I wanted to develop the technical skills needed to turn data into meaningful insights. I am especially interested in learning how statistical methods and computational tools can be applied to practical problems. Through the MDS program, I hope to become a more effective problem solver and gain experience working on real-world data projects.

## Outside of Data Science

Outside of my studies, I enjoy cycling, photography, and playing badminton. Cycling gives me an opportunity to explore new places, while photography allows me to capture interesting moments and perspectives. I also enjoy playing badminton as a way to stay active and spend time with friends.
